verses.1: For I have considered this for myself: that I might not have to come to you again in sorrow.
verses.2: For if I truly pity you, then who else can be the one who expresses pity for me, except those who are also pitied by me?
verses.3: And I wrote this so that I might not cause any sorrow to those who deserve to be happy. I believe in you all; my happiness is truly your happiness.
verses.4: For from much sorrow and unity of heart, I have written to you through many tears. Not so that you would grieve, but so that you would know how much love I have for you.
verses.5: If anyone is upset, it’s not me who is upset, but rather, I do this so that I won’t burden you all too much.
verses.6: Such praise is not worthy of being given by many people.
verses.7: So, I would like to give you this more willingly and ask for your help. I don’t want this person to be further hurt by this.
verses.8: Therefore, I beg you to show love for him.
verses.9: For this very reason, I wrote down these words, so that you may know whether you are truly unfit for anything at all.
verses.10: What you give, I will also give. For indeed, whatever I am willing to give, I will do so on behalf of you, in the face of Christ.
verses.11: So that we may not be dominated by Satan; for we must not ignore his teachings at all.
verses.12: And when I went to Troas, to the place of the gospel of Christ, a door was opened for me in the Lord.
verses.13: I didn’t wait for my spirit to find me along with my brother Titus. Instead, I decided to go to Makedonia instead.
verses.14: And by the grace of God, we are always comforted in Christ. The scent of His knowledge is also revealed through us in every place.
verses.15: Because Christ’s righteousness is always present before God, both among those who are saved and among those who are lost.
verses.16: One is the smell of death from death itself, and the other is the smell of life from life itself. And who is capable of handling this?
verses.17: For we do not speak as many people do who preach the word of God. Instead, we speak from a place of truthfulness, and we speak in opposition to God through Christ.
